name: user_asks_for_employment_letter_with_international_email
goal: User with an international (non-.in) email requests an employment letter.
constraints: Employee details must be present. Email is international.

phases.description: Bot displays employee details and options, showing international email.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays email with correct international domain.
Bot proceeds to trigger mail workflow silently.

phases.description: Bot triggers mail and confirms success.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays the exact confirmation message for employment letter request.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
